messages:
jessica_support: Customer (Acme Analytics) reporting failures on /v1/tools/invoke when calling our billing-tool. They see a 400 schema validation error. customer_id=acme-42

jessica_support: attaching minimal payload they sent:
```json
{
  "tool": "billing-tool",
  "args": {
    "invoice_id": "inv_9876",
    "amount": "1250",  // string instead of number
    "billing_profile": null,
    "debug_mode": true  // extra prop from client SDK
  }
}
```

jessica_support: API response body:
```json
{
  "error": "schema validation failed",
  "details": [
    "additionalProperties \u2018debug_mode\u2019 not allowed at /args",
    "required property \u2018billing_profile.id\u2019 is missing",
    "type mismatch at /args/amount: expected number but got string"
  ]
}
```

mike_eng: can you paste the curl request (headers + body) and the full response headers? need to repro. do you have a request_id from the customer?

jessica_support: sent full curl and response headers to the ticket (TKT-3342). request_id header x-rid=rid_20240317_0923

ingrid_schema: quick read: three issues in one. 1) client sent extra debug_mode (additionalProperties). 2) billing_profile is present but null; schema requires an object with id. 3) amount is a string.

ingrid_schema: repro locally with the payload, our JSONSchema validator (ajv) returns same errors. sample failing validation output:
```
errors: [
  {instancePath: "/args", message: "must NOT have additional properties"},
  {instancePath: "/args/billing_profile", message: "must have required property 'id'"},
  {instancePath: "/args/amount", message: "must be number"}
]
```

mike_eng: rough impact: customer hit this after upgrading from our old SDK which implicitly sent billing_profile as {id: '...'} but new shim can send null. also some SDKs set debug_mode on debug builds.

ingrid_schema: remediation options:
- short term (support): strip unknown props and coerce amount to number on our invoke path before schema validation; accept billing_profile=null and map to error that asks customer to provide id (better UX)
- medium: add a lenient compatibility layer that accepts debug_mode and coerces numeric strings (opt-in per customer)
- long term: bump spec and notify SDKs and customers (breaking).

jessica_support: applied short-term patch in proxy for Acme (strip debug_mode + coerce amount). customer confirms their request now succeeds. added note to TKT-3342 with workaround steps. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Incident created INC-3342 for schema compatibility issue (priority=P2). Assigned to #eng-ml and #eng-platform.

mike_eng: ingrid, can you open a small RFC/PR to add an explicit compatibility policy? include tests for amount coercion and null billing_profile mapping. we'll review in next sprint.

ingrid_schema: will do. adding a test matrix and a feature flag so we can roll to affected customers only.

sre_oncall: flagging for deploy review - proxy change was hotfixed for one customer. need canary and rollback plan before wide rollout.

jessica_support: logging final customer acknowledgement: Acme will delay SDK upgrade until we ship compatibility shim. leaving ticket open for plumbing.

mike_eng: thanks all. tagging @ingrid_schema @sre_oncall for follow-ups.

jessica_support: closing this slack thread, will update ticket when RFC/PR lands.
